literal_meaning: দ্রুত নুড়ি তুলতে সক্ষম হাত (hands quick to pick up pebbles)
figurative_meaning_en: A boy who is capable of helping with tasks and chores
example_sentences_in_bangla: ছেলেটা বেশ হাত নুড়কুৎ হয়ে উঠেছে।
গ্রামের এই ছেলেটি সব কাজে হাত নুড়কুৎ।
example_sentences_in_english: The boy has become quite handy with tasks.
This village boy is a real handy helper in all chores.
note: Refers to dexterity and willingness to assist, often in rural Bengali contexts
